Package com.im.njams.sdk.model.svg

Class PolylineProcessDiagramFactory

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.model.svg.NjamsProcessDiagramFactory
      • com.im.njams.sdk.model.svg.PolylineProcessDiagramFactory
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ProcessDiagramFactory
    public class PolylineProcessDiagramFactory
extends NjamsProcessDiagramFactory
    Process diagram factory that renders transitions as routed poly-lines instead of straight lines.

    Activity placement is taken as-is from the configured layouter; only the transition edges are drawn differently: each edge is routed orthogonally through the free gutters (between columns) and channels (between rows) so that no transition arrow overlaps an activity node or runs collinearly through one. This resolves the unreadable cases of the default straight-line rendering — most notably a stepless bypass (a direct fork→convergence edge with no intermediate activity), as well as choice fan-out and convergence.

    This factory is an opt-in replacement for NjamsProcessDiagramFactory; the default rendering is unchanged. Select it per client via njams.model().setDiagramFactory(new PolylineProcessDiagramFactory(njams)).

    Activity, group and SVG-document handling are inherited unchanged from NjamsProcessDiagramFactory. Edges whose endpoints are not plain activities of the same container (for example edges touching a group border) fall back to the inherited straight-line rendering.
